knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The first-job procedure says to review the brief, hazards, site rules and PPE before touching equipment. A damaged lead must not be used.
The worked decision is that a damaged power lead is isolated, not used, and reported. Repairing or taping live equipment is unsafe.
The lesson states that the assessor records direct observations and that attendance alone is not competence. The result is checked against the criteria.

practicalCriteria: Learner confirms the work order and scope with the supervisor and completes the pre-start checklist before the observed job.
Learner carries out each step of the approved procedure in order for a supervised job, and stops and reports any step they are unsure of.
Learner completes the completion checklist and records the outcome, any defect and any incomplete item on the job record.
Supervisor marks each signoff criterion as met, not met or not yet observed, and any criterion not met is re-tested at a later job.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Signed signoff record with each criterion marked met, not met or not yet observed
Completed job record and completion checklist
Record of any error, correction and defect found during the job
stopWorkCriteria: Learner performs a step that has not been demonstrated
Learner conceals an error during the observed job
